cohort: Young adults enrolled in the 1982 and 1993 Pelotas birth cohorts, Rio Grande do Sul State, Brasil
finding: After adjusting for confounding variables, mode of delivery was not significantly associated with human capital outcomes in adulthood.
mod_finding: This study investigated the association between mode of delivery and human capital in young adults, finding that initial positive associations between cesarean section and human capital were strongly reduced after controlling for confounders.
